proposal.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Reject every preregistered mutation and emit only the declared bounded software, symbolic, formal, numerical, or structural completion.
proposal.hypothesis: A bounded MVCC write-skew and serialization control artifact can expose declared obligations while refusing unsupported scientific, operational, identity, or authority promotion.
proposal.novelty_against_860_frozen_proposals: Prior database work covers WAL and snapshots, but no frozen proposal isolates write skew, predicate conflict, serialization refusal, and retry evidence.
proposal.null_or_failure_condition: The artifact omits a declared MVCC write-skew and serialization control obligation, accepts a preregistered mutation, erases a negative, or promotes a result beyond its evidence lane.
proposal.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the proposal, retain every failed witness, rewrite no history, and leave external, sibling, participant, production, and authority state unchanged.
proposal.title: Method Flow MVCC snapshot-isolation, write-skew, predicate-conflict, serialization-failure, retry, starvation, teardown, and evidence-credit tribunal
